evals.name: goal-loop-flaky-tests
evals.prompt: The auth module's tests are flaky and I keep getting random CI failures. Can you just get them stable?
evals.expected_output: Agent upgrades the vague ask into a six-field goal (outcome, verification surface, constraints, boundaries, iteration policy, stop conditions) via a one-question-at-a-time interview, proposes a guarded goal-loop execution mode with an iteration cap / budget / no-progress detection, and waits for explicit confirmation before executing. Does NOT start blindly editing tests.

evals.name: periodic-deploy-watch
evals.prompt: We're deploying the new pricing service this afternoon. Keep an eye on it and let me know if error rates spike.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this as recurring/time-based work and lands on periodic mode (/loop with a cadence and a status command), pins a verification surface (what 'error rates spike' means, threshold), sets a checkpoint discipline, and confirms before starting. Does NOT treat it as a one-shot task.

evals.name: vague-make-codebase-better
evals.prompt: I want to accomplish making our codebase better.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to overshoot. It interviews hard to extract a concrete, verifiable outcome before doing anything, insists on a measurable verification surface, and does NOT fire off a large lifecycle/delegation chain or start refactoring on a guess.
